# Security policy

## Reporting a security problem

If you find a security issue in **Immersion**, please report it privately — don't post it publicly.

- **Inside the app:** use **Report a Problem**. It reaches us directly and attaches the details we need.
- **Or:** [kvrnl.io/contact](https://kvrnl.io/contact/)

Tell us what you found, how to reproduce it, and the version you're on. We'll acknowledge your
report and keep you posted on the fix.

## Supported versions

Only the **latest release** of Immersion receives security fixes. The app updates itself, so
staying current is automatic.

| Version | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| Latest release | ✅ |
| Older releases | ❌ |

## Please don't

- Test against KVRNL servers in ways that could disrupt service.
- Access, change, or delete other people's data.
- Publish the issue before we've had a chance to fix it.

Thanks for helping keep KVRNL users safe.
